EmptyResponse.description: Successful request without a response body.

ShippingMethodListResponse.description: Entity search result containing shipping methods.

SeoUrlListResponse.description: Entity search result containing seo urls.

OpenApi3.description: Returns information about the store API.

CategoryListResponse.description: Categories of the requested page. `parentId` is `null` for root categories, `showInMenu` tells whether the category is shown in the navigation, `productCount` counts its active products, `position` is its place among the categories with the same `parentId` in the navigation (`null` for root categories), `listProperties` names the properties to show on its product cards, `icon` is its icon file (`null` without icon), `sortings` names the sortings of its product list and `filterProperties` the properties to filter it by.

ContextTokenResponse.description: The response header `sw-context-token` contains the token of the session. Send it as `sw-context-token` header with every following request.

redirectUrl.description: Storefront redirect target; `null` for Store API logins.

CountryListResponse.description: Countries a customer can choose for shipping addresses.

default.description: `true` for Germany, the country to preselect in the address form; `false` for every other country.

postalCodeRequired.description: Whether an address in this country needs a postal code.

ProductListResponse.description: Products of the requested page. `productType` is `PRODUCT`, `SET` or `BUNDLE`; sets and bundles list their products under `bundleProducts`.

limit.description: Maximum number of products requested per page.

sort.description: Applied sort order, with direction: the requested `sort`, otherwise, with exactly one `categoryId`, the default of the category (`sortings.default` in `GET /category`), else `-popularity`.

facets.description: With exactly one `categoryId`: the filterable properties of the category (`filterProperties` in `GET /category`) with their values and product counts, in the order of `filterProperties`. A property without values is left out. Empty list without `categoryId` or with several categories; the filter `properties` still applies.

elements.name: EcoFlow Dummy PowerOcean Junction Box Batterie Zubehör

ProductSearchResponse.description: Products matching the search term. Without a match `elements` is empty and `total` is 0.

limit.description: Maximum number of products requested per page.

sort.description: Applied sort order. Always `relevance`: the results are sorted by relevance to the term.

facets.description: With exactly one `categoryId`: the filterable properties of the category (`filterProperties` in `GET /category`) with their values and product counts, in the order of `filterProperties`. A property without values is left out. Empty list without `categoryId` or with several categories; the filter `properties` still applies.

searchLogId.description: ID of this search for `POST /store-api/v1/search-log/click/{searchLogId}`. `null` if the search is not recorded: without `term`, without `source`, on later pages (`page` greater than 1) or when the shop records no searches. For clicks on later pages use the ID of the first page; if that is `null` too, send no clicks.

noResults.description: Returned with HTTP 200 when the search term matches no product.

swLanguageId.name: sw-language-id
swLanguageId.description: Instructs Shopware to return the response in the given language.

criteriaTerm.name: term
criteriaTerm.description: Search term. Without a term the result contains no products.

criteriaFilter.name: filter[]
criteriaFilter.description: List of filters to restrict the search result. For more information, see [Search Queries > Filter](https://shopware.stoplight.io/docs/store-api/v1/docs/concepts/search-queries.md#filter)

criteriaIds.name: ids[]
criteriaIds.description: List of ids to search for

criteriaQuery.name: query
criteriaQuery.description: The query string to search for

criteriaPostFilter.name: post-filter[]
criteriaPostFilter.description: Filters that applied without affecting aggregations. For more information, see [Search Queries > Post Filter](https://shopware.stoplight.io/docs/store-api/v1/docs/concepts/search-queries.md#post-filter)

criteriaFields.name: fields[]
criteriaFields.description: Fields which should be returned in the search result.

criteriaTotalCountMode.name: total-count-mode
criteriaTotalCountMode.description: Controls whether a totalCount is returned: none/0 omits it, exact/1 returns the exact total, next-pages/2 returns a lower bound.

criteriaIncludes.name: includes
criteriaIncludes.description: Specify the fields that should be returned for the given entities. Object key needs to be the entity name, and the list of fields needs to be the value. Fields will not be included, if they are also specified in the excludes. Note that the include fields will only be stripped on the API-Level, consider using the `fields` parameter for performance reasons.

criteriaExcludes.name: excludes
criteriaExcludes.description: Specify the fields that should be excluded from the response for the given entities. Object key needs to be the entity name, and the list of fields needs to be the value. Note that the exclude fields will only be stripped on the API-Level, consider using the `fields` parameter for performance reasons.

CompressedCriteria.name: _criteria
CompressedCriteria.description: Compressed and encoded criteria object. Format: base64url(gzip(json_encode(criteria))). This parameter allows passing complex criteria as a single encoded string instead of multiple query parameters. The criteria object should be JSON-encoded, then gzipped, and finally base64url-encoded. The criteria object structure is defined in the Criteria schema (see #/components/schemas/Criteria).

CompressedNoneFieldsCriteria.name: _criteria
CompressedNoneFieldsCriteria.description: Compressed and encoded criteria object. Format: base64url(gzip(json_encode(criteria))). This parameter allows passing complex criteria as a single encoded string instead of multiple query parameters. The criteria object should be JSON-encoded, then gzipped, and finally base64url-encoded. The criteria object structure is defined in the NoneFieldsCriteria schema (see #/components/schemas/NoneFieldsCriteria).

noAggregations.name: no-aggregations
noAggregations.description: Resets all aggregations in the criteria. This parameter is a flag, the value has no effect.

onlyAggregations.name: only-aggregations
onlyAggregations.description: If this flag is set, no products are fetched. Sorting and associations are also ignored. This parameter is a flag, the value has no effect.

criteriaProductIds.name: productIds
criteriaProductIds.description: Filter products by one or more product IDs. Pass multiple IDs as a comma-separated list, e.g. `<productId>,<productId>`. A value that is not an ID returns `400` with `STROMBAUER_STORE_API__INVALID_ID/productIds`.

criteriaCategoryId.name: categoryId
criteriaCategoryId.description: Filter products by one or more category IDs. Pass multiple IDs as a comma-separated list. Returns the products the category shows in its listing, including subcategories and categories filled by a product stream or a tag. A value that is not an ID returns `400` with `STROMBAUER_STORE_API__INVALID_ID/categoryId`.

criteriaManufacturerId.name: manufacturerId
criteriaManufacturerId.description: Filter products by one or more manufacturer IDs. Pass multiple IDs as a comma-separated list. A value that is not an ID returns `400` with `STROMBAUER_STORE_API__INVALID_ID/manufacturerId`.

criteriaProperties.name: properties
criteriaProperties.description: Filter products by property values (the `id` of a value in `facets`). Pass multiple IDs as a comma-separated list. Values of the same property are combined with OR, values of different properties with AND: `properties=<11 kW>,<22 kW>,<3-phase>` returns products with 11 kW or 22 kW that are also 3-phase. `total` and the pages count the filtered products. An ID that is not a property value returns no products. A value that is not an ID returns `400` with `STROMBAUER_STORE_API__INVALID_ID/properties`.

ApiKey.description: Required for every request. Identifies the sales channel via the `sw-access-key` header.
ApiKey.name: sw-access-key

ContextToken.description: Identifies a logged-in customer session via the `sw-context-token` header. Required in addition to `sw-access-key` on endpoints that require login.
ContextToken.name: sw-context-token
